description:
Rank device MODELS by any battery metric, aggregating across every device
of that model. This is the tool for 'which phone model has the best battery
life', 'which models charge fastest', 'which run hottest' — questions that
would otherwise need one `model_summary` call per model.

Ordering is by the per-model MEDIAN of the metric (outlier-resistant); the
mean is returned alongside. Use `brand` to rank within one manufacturer and
`min_devices` to require a minimum sample size.

brand.description: Optional lowercase brand filter. When omitted, devices from any brand are ranked together.

metric.description: Which battery metric to rank on. One of: 'temperature_c' (mean battery temperature, C), 'max_temperature_c' / 'min_temperature_c' (hottest / coldest ever seen, C), 'battery_level_pct' (mean charge level, 0-100), 'discharge_hours' (hours to drain a full 100% - HIGHER means longer battery life), 'ac_charge_hours' / 'usb_charge_hours' / 'wireless_charge_hours' (hours to charge a full 100% on that source - LOWER means faster charging), 'awake_ratio' (fraction of time awake / screen-on, 0..1), 'snapshot_count' (how much data the device contributed), 'uptime_hours' (longest single uptime between reboots).

min_devices.description: Ignore models backed by fewer devices than this. Defaults to 3 so a single outlier phone cannot win a ranking. Raise it for more robust comparisons.

order.description: 'desc' (default) ranks the highest values first, 'asc' the lowest. Pick the direction that matches the question: fastest charging is ac_charge_hours + asc; longest battery life is discharge_hours + desc.

name: top_models

device_count.description: Distinct devices of this model contributing a value.

mean_value.description: Mean of the metric across the model's devices.

median_value.description: Median of the metric across the model's devices — the value the ranking is ordered by, as it resists outliers.

raw_model_code.description: Representative raw Build.MODEL identifier for URL building.

snapshot_count.description: Total snapshots behind this model's devices.

url.description: Public BatterySnap page for this model; null when raw_model_code is null.

title: Rank models by metric
